name: vibeguard-monorepo
description: VibeGuard - Security for the AI-Built Software Era

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/security-engine && npm run build --workspace=packages/ai-engine && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:scanners: npm run build --workspace=scanners/semgrep && npm run build --workspace=scanners/gitleaks && npm run build --workspace=scanners/npm-audit && npm run build --workspace=scanners/trivy && npm run build --workspace=scanners/checkov && npm run build --workspace=scanners/zap && npm run build --workspace=scanners/aws-cspm
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build:scanners
